import Foundation
final class EditedValue { var text = "Changed" }
let value = EditedValue()
let manager = UndoManager()
manager.groupsByEvent = false
manager.beginUndoGrouping()
manager.registerUndo(withTarget: value) { $0.text = "Original" }
manager.setActionName("Edit Title")
manager.endUndoGrouping()
print("Before empty group:", manager.undoActionName)
manager.beginUndoGrouping()
manager.endUndoGrouping()
print("After empty group:", manager.undoActionName)
manager.undo()
print("After one Undo:", value.text, manager.undoActionName)
stdout:
Before empty group: Edit Title
After empty group: 
After one Undo: Changed Edit Title
